description_en: Removes one or more rules in an account group from a compliance package
description_zh: 将指定账号组规则从指定账号组合规包中移出
kebab_example: aliyun config detach-aggregate-config-rule-to-compliance-pack --config-rule-ids cr-a124626622af00e70000 --compliance-pack-id cp-5bb1626622af00bd0000 --aggregator-id ca-75b4626622af00c30000 --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DetachAggregateConfigRuleToCompliancePack

parameters.description_en:
The rule IDs. Separate multiple rule IDs with commas (,).

For more information about how to obtain the ID of a rule, see [ListAggregateConfigRules](~~264148~~).

规则ID。多个规则ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔。
